modmenu.descriptionTranslation.abyssal_d: A thirty-floor roguelike dungeon beneath the world.
zone.abyssal_descent.forgotten_halls.tag: Where the first delvers were laid to rest, and did not stay there.
zone.abyssal_descent.ashen_forge.tagline: The anvils still ring for a king no one remembers.
zone.abyssal_descent.crystal_depths.tagl: Every facet hums. Something listens back.
zone.abyssal_descent.drowned_kingdom.tag: The tide came in, and the court never left.
zone.abyssal_descent.blood_citadel.tagli: Its walls are mortared with oaths, and oaths demand payment.
zone.abyssal_descent.abyssal_throne.tagl: At the bottom of everything, a seat. And on it, a hunger.
tooltip.abyssal_descent.relic_hint: Active in your hotbar or off-hand
tooltip.abyssal_descent.unsecured.hint: Lost if you fall. Extract at a waystone to keep it.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.sunder.name: Sunder
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.sunder: +%s damage per point of the target's armor, up to +%s.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.bleed.name: Rend
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.bleed: Critical hits make the target bleed for %s seconds.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.soul_flare: Fully charged hits have a %s%% chance to erupt in soul fire, dealing %s damage to nearby foes.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.chain_lightn: Fully charged hits have a %s%% chance to arc lightning through up to %s more foes for %s damage.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.grave_slam: Falling critical hits send out a shockwave dealing %s damage within %s blocks.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.soulreaver: Fully charged critical hits loose a wave of soul fire, dealing %s damage along a %s-block line.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.reap_souls: Kills draw the victim's soul into you, restoring %s health.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.soul_pierce: Arrows pass through %s extra foes and strike harder.
effect_desc.abyssal_descent.bone_shrapne: Bolts burst on impact, dealing %s damage to foes within %s blocks.
relic.abyssal_descent.vigil_candle.name: Vigil
relic.abyssal_descent.vigil_candle: Reveals false walls and traps around you. Immunity to Blindness and Darkness.
relic.abyssal_descent.cracked_phylactery: Kills have a 20% chance to restore 1.5 hearts. +15% damage while below 30% health.
relic.abyssal_descent.blood_sigil.name: Blood Pact
relic.abyssal_descent.blood_sigil: Bleeding you inflict lasts 50% longer. +10% damage against bleeding foes.
relic.abyssal_descent.hollow_crown.name: Dominion of Bone
relic.abyssal_descent.hollow_crown: Undead near you are slowed and deal 15% less damage to you.
set.abyssal_descent.gravewarden.four: (4) Deathward: once every 90 seconds, survive a lethal blow and blast nearby foes away.
set.abyssal_descent.mourner.four: (4) Veil: after 3 seconds unharmed, your next hit deals +40% damage.
set.abyssal_descent.wraithbound.four: (4) Soul Hunger: kills restore 1.5 hearts and grant a burst of speed. Curse: you take 15% more damage.
item.abyssal_descent.crypt_shortsword.fl: Standard issue for the crypt guard. The guard did not survive the issue.
item.abyssal_descent.gravediggers_hatche: Made for roots and coffin lids. Works on shields too.
item.abyssal_descent.bone_shiv.flavor: Whittled from a femur by someone who needed it more than its owner did.
item.abyssal_descent.ossuary_blade.flavo: Etched with the names of the dead it was meant to keep down.
item.abyssal_descent.mourners_kris.flavo: A wavy blade for wounds that will not close.
item.abyssal_descent.wightbane.flavor: The fuller burns cold blue whenever the dead draw near.
item.abyssal_descent.cryptwarden_longbow: Strung with braided grave-silk. Its arrows remember the way home.
item.abyssal_descent.bonecaster.flavor: Loads splintered bone. Delivers it more splintered.
item.abyssal_descent.tombsplitter.flavor: Built to break seals that were never meant to be broken.
item.abyssal_descent.stormvigil.flavor: Forged during a storm by a smith who swore never to stop watching.
item.abyssal_descent.gravebrand.flavor: The Hollow Warden's blade. It still hungers for the souls it was sworn to guard.
item.abyssal_descent.gravewarden_helm.fl: The visor is welded shut. The wearer was not consulted.
item.abyssal_descent.gravewarden_greaves: Heavy enough to stand a post for three hundred years.
item.abyssal_descent.gravewarden_sabaton: They never once retreated. That was rather the problem.
item.abyssal_descent.mourner_hood.flavor: Woven for the ones who keep vigil, and are never seen.
item.abyssal_descent.mourner_shroud.flav: Grief is quiet. So is the one wearing this.
item.abyssal_descent.mourner_wraps.flavo: Bound tight against the cold of the crypts.
item.abyssal_descent.mourner_treads.flav: Soft soles for walking among sleepers.
The face behind the mask is yours now. The hunger behind it is not.
Woven from the shrouds of those who swore to rise again.
item.abyssal_descent.wraithbound_legguar: Every step drags a little life with it.
Swift as a wraith, and as welcome.
item.abyssal_descent.gravedust_locket.fl: Holds a pinch of someone. They seem to approve of you.
item.abyssal_descent.vigil_candle.flavor: Its flame leans toward what is hidden.
item.abyssal_descent.blood_sigil.flavor: A pact signed in a hand that was not entirely willing.
The soul inside is leaking. It doesn't mind sharing.
item.abyssal_descent.hollow_crown.flavor: Taken from the Warden's brow. The dead still kneel to it.
item.abyssal_descent.waystone_shard.desc: Use in the depths to channel an extraction. Keeps all unsecured loot; taking damage interrupts it.
affix.abyssal_descent.title: %s %s
death.attack.abyssal_descent.spikes: %1$s was impaled on a spike trap
death.attack.abyssal_descent.spikes.play: %1$s was impaled on a spike trap whilst fighting %2$s
%1$s was consumed by soul fire whilst fighting %2$s
%1$s was consumed by %2$s's soul fire using %3$s
death.attack.abyssal_descent.soul_erupti: %1$s was engulfed by an eruption of souls
%1$s was engulfed by an eruption of souls whilst fighting %2$s
%1$s was engulfed by souls called up by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.abyssal_descent.shockwave.p: %1$s was crushed by a shockwave whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.abyssal_descent.chain_light: %1$s was struck by arcing lightning whilst fighting %2$s
%1$s was struck down by %2$s's lightning using %3$s
boss.abyssal_descent.hollow_warden.title: Hollow Warden
boss.abyssal_descent.hollow_warden.phase: The Warden's armor splits, and soul fire pours from the cracks.
"I will not let you pass." The Warden burns with everything it has left.
boss.abyssal_descent.hollow_warden.raise: The Warden calls its fallen guard back from the dust.
message.abyssal_descent.reliquary.claime: You have already claimed this reliquary.
message.abyssal_descent.sealed_below: The way to %s is sealed for now. Deeper zones open in a future update.
message.abyssal_descent.shard.no_run: The shard is cold. It only answers within an expedition.
message.abyssal_descent.shard.sealed: The seals smother the shard's light. Finish the fight first.
message.abyssal_descent.encounter.elite: An elite stirs! The chamber is sealed.
message.abyssal_descent.encounter.trial: The trial begins! The chamber is sealed.
message.abyssal_descent.encounter.pulled: The seals drag you back into the fight.
message.abyssal_descent.gate.inert: The gate is silent here. It only opens from the surface.
message.abyssal_descent.gate.already_in_: You are already on an expedition.
message.abyssal_descent.gate.missing_dim: The depths could not be found. Is the mod installed on the server?
message.abyssal_descent.gate.attuning: %s is attuning the gate. Stand close within %s seconds to join the descent to %s.
message.abyssal_descent.gate.no_checkpoi: Defeat a zone guardian to unlock a deeper starting floor.
message.abyssal_descent.gate.checkpoint_: %s hasn't unlocked floor %s yet. The party starts from floor 1.
message.abyssal_descent.exit_found: You sense the descent rift nearby.
message.abyssal_descent.descent_interrup: The descent falters. The whole party must stand within the rift.
message.abyssal_descent.checkpoint_unloc: Checkpoint unlocked: you may now begin expeditions on floor %s (%s).
message.abyssal_descent.boss_reward: The guardian falls. A rift opens toward %s, and a waystone offers a way home.
message.abyssal_descent.boss_reward_seal: The guardian falls. A waystone offers a way home. %s still lies sealed below.
message.abyssal_descent.waystone.idle: The waystone hums quietly. It answers only to delvers.
message.abyssal_descent.waystone.confirm: Use the waystone again to extract and secure %s unsecured items.
message.abyssal_descent.defeated.sub: Fell on floor %s. %s unsecured items lost.
message.abyssal_descent.shrine.inert: The shrine is dormant outside an expedition.
message.abyssal_descent.shrine.busy: The shrine cannot be roused while the chamber is in combat.
message.abyssal_descent.trial.begin: %s has invoked the Altar of Trials!
message.abyssal_descent.idol.offer: The idol whispers of treasure, for a price that lasts until you leave the depths. Use it again to accept.
message.abyssal_descent.idol.accepted: You accept the idol's bargain and are marked with %s.
message.abyssal_descent.run_lost: Your expedition ended while you were away. You have been returned to the surface.
message.abyssal_descent.abandoned: You left the depths without a waystone. Your expedition is over and your unsecured loot is lost.
command.abyssal_descent.stats.line: Expeditions: %s  Deepest floor: %s  Guardians slain: %s  Extractions: %s  Defeats: %s
command.abyssal_descent.rules.1: Loot found in the depths is Unsecured until you extract at a waystone or with a Waystone Shard.
command.abyssal_descent.rules.2: Falling in the depths returns you to the surface. Unsecured loot is lost and your gear takes a durability toll.
command.abyssal_descent.rules.3: Everything you brought with you, and everything already secured, is kept.
command.abyssal_descent.rules.4: Defeating a zone guardian unlocks the next zone as a permanent starting floor.
command.abyssal_descent.rules.5: Leaving the depths any other way abandons the expedition and forfeits unsecured loot.
